items.text:
A fun game where you can scavenge ships for parts and even go on atmospheric races.

My experiences thus far:
1. Scavenge enough to expand my crew to two.
2. Get the message my crew is in trouble, only to find her suffocating because she put on a helmet with no oxygen.
3. Get the message my crew is in trouble, only to find she decided to go on a space-walk without any kind of enviroment suit.
4. Try to dock with the main station, get crushed into oblivion by another ship.

But seriously, this game still needs a lot of polish. But the potential for a great game is already there.

Protip: Save often.

10/10 would continue playing.
items.text_zh:
一款有趣的游戏，你可以从飞船上 scavenge 零件，甚至还能参加大气层竞速。

到目前为止我的经历：
1. 搜刮到足够资源，把我的船员扩充到两人。
2. 收到消息说我的船员有麻烦，结果发现她因为戴上了没有氧气的头盔而窒息。
3. 收到消息说我的船员有麻烦，结果发现她决定不穿任何环境服就去太空行走。
4. 尝试与主空间站对接，被另一艘飞船碾成齑粉。

但说真的，这游戏还需要大量打磨。不过，成为一款伟大游戏的潜力已经存在了。

专业提示：经常存档。

10/10，会继续玩下去。

observations.description: 对接主站时被其他飞船撞毁
observations.evidence: Try to dock with the main station, get crushed into oblivion by another ship.
observations.evidence_zh: 尝试与主空间站对接，结果被另一艘船碾成了虚无。

items.text:
I love the level of detail the game has. It has mesmerized me for hours at a time. It is more than worth the money. Just be warned, the hours played come to a quick halt when the save doesn't work. Now the patrol ships shake you down for money if you undock from a derelict. I just had one ram me and push me into another derelict to the destruction of my ship. Like I said before, it's a great game but still has quite a few bugs to get ironed out.

Edit: I loved this game a few years ago. A lot more has been put into it since then. I wish there were less bugs and more Qol changes but there you have it. It is still a great game at its core, or at least has that potential. I hope the dev doesn't give up and keeps working at it until Ostranauts becomes the classis it is meant to be.
items.text_zh:
我喜欢这款游戏的细节程度。它让我一连几个小时都着迷。它绝对物超所值。只是要提醒一句，当存档不能用时，你玩的小时数就会戛然而止。现在如果你从一艘废弃船上脱离对接，巡逻船就会向你勒索钱财。我刚刚就遇到一艘撞上我，把我推进另一艘废弃船，导致我的飞船被毁。就像我之前说的，这是一款很棒的游戏，但仍有不少bug需要解决。

编辑：几年前我很喜欢这款游戏。自那以后它加入了很多内容。我希望bug能少一些，生活质量改动能多一些，但情况就是这样。它的核心仍然是一款很棒的游戏，或者至少有这样的潜力。我希望开发者不要放弃，继续努力，直到Ostranauts成为它注定要成为的经典。

observations.evidence: I just had one ram me and push me into another derelict to the destruction of my ship
